title: GovDeals Acquisition Intelligence Pipeline — Input
description: Configure GovDeals crawling, optional eBay comp enrichment, webhook delivery, dedupe behavior, and governed export outputs.

sourceName.title: Source Name
sourceName.description: Logical source label for this run. Useful for auditability and downstream lineage.

runLabel.title: Run Label
runLabel.description: Optional operator label for this run, such as 'phones-test-run' or 'nightly-auction-scan'.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: GovDeals category or search result URLs to crawl.

recheckLots.title: Recheck Lots
recheckLots.description: Force-fetch only these GovDeals lots for QA, bypassing search and dedupe skips. Enter detail URLs, govdeals-{accountId}-{assetId} IDs, or assetId/accountId pairs.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Optional search terms. Empty = search '*' (all lots).

maxPages.title: Max Pages per Category / Search
maxPages.description: Max search pages (500 lots each). 0 = all pages (~51). Use 1 for the canary.

maxItemsPerRun.title: Max Items per Run
maxItemsPerRun.description: Cap on lots for which detail + fees are fetched this run. 0 = no cap. Canary: 20.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel browser pages. Keep low for anti-bot safety.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max Request Retries
maxRequestRetries.description: How many times to retry a failed page request before giving up.

proxyEnabled.title: Enable Proxy
proxyEnabled.description: Ignored by the GovDeals API transport (it runs without a proxy). Kept for compatibility.

dedupePersistInterval.title: Dedupe Persist Interval
dedupePersistInterval.description: How many processed records to accumulate before persisting dedupe state.

enableFingerprintRefresh.title: Enable Fingerprint Refresh
enableFingerprintRefresh.description: Reprocess a listing if its content fingerprint changes across runs.

enableStaleRefresh.title: Enable Stale Refresh
enableStaleRefresh.description: Reprocess a listing after it becomes stale, even if unchanged.

staleAfterMinutes.title: Stale Refresh Threshold (minutes)
staleAfterMinutes.description: Minutes after which an unchanged listing becomes eligible for refresh.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable verbose logging and extraction diagnostics.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: HTTP(S) endpoint to POST normalized records to.

webhookAuthToken.title: Webhook Auth Token
webhookAuthToken.description: Bearer token used for webhook authorization.

webhookBatchSize.title: Webhook Batch Size
webhookBatchSize.description: Number of records per webhook POST.

webhookMaxRetries.title: Webhook Max Retries
webhookMaxRetries.description: Maximum retries on retryable webhook failures.

webhookReplayDeadLetterOnStart.title: Replay Dead Letter on Start
webhookReplayDeadLetterOnStart.description: Attempt replay of dead-letter webhook batches at the start of a run.

webhookDeliveryRequired.title: Require Webhook Delivery
webhookDeliveryRequired.description: Fail the Actor run if any webhook batch cannot be delivered after configured retries.

ebayClientId.title: eBay Client ID
ebayClientId.description: eBay Developer Client ID / App ID.

ebayClientSecret.title: eBay Client Secret
ebayClientSecret.description: OAuth Client Secret for eBay token exchange.

ebayEnvironment.title: eBay Environment
ebayEnvironment.description: Use production for live data or sandbox for testing.

ebayCategoryIds.title: eBay Category IDs
ebayCategoryIds.description: Category IDs for eBay listing retrieval.

ebayMaxResults.title: eBay Max Results per Query
ebayMaxResults.description: Maximum total listings per eBay query.

ebayIncludeSoldComps.title: Include eBay Sold Comps
ebayIncludeSoldComps.description: Also fetch completed/sold listings from eBay as comparables.

csvExportEnabled.title: Enable CSV Export
csvExportEnabled.description: Export normalized records to CSV after completion.

csvExportProfile.title: CSV Export Profile
csvExportProfile.description: Column profile to use for CSV export.

csvOutputDir.title: CSV Output Directory
csvOutputDir.description: Directory path for exported CSV files.

csvFileName.title: CSV File Name
csvFileName.description: Name of the exported CSV file.

googleSheetId.title: Google Sheet ID
googleSheetId.description: Spreadsheet ID from the Google Sheets URL.

googleSheetName.title: Google Sheet Tab Name
googleSheetName.description: Name of the sheet/tab to write data to.

googleSheetsExportProfile.title: Google Sheets Export Profile
googleSheetsExportProfile.description: Column profile to use for Google Sheets export.

googleServiceAccountKey.title: Google Service Account Key
googleServiceAccountKey.description: Service account JSON string or file path.

sqlExportEnabled.title: Enable SQL Export
sqlExportEnabled.description: Generate a SQL ingest file after the crawl completes.

sqlExportProfile.title: SQL Export Profile
sqlExportProfile.description: Logical SQL export profile for batch generation.

sqlWrapInTransaction.title: Wrap SQL Export in Transaction
sqlWrapInTransaction.description: Wrap generated SQL statements in BEGIN/COMMIT.

sqlOutputDir.title: SQL Output Directory
sqlOutputDir.description: Directory path for SQL export files.

sqlFileName.title: SQL File Name
sqlFileName.description: Name of the SQL output file.

govdealsApiKey.title: GovDeals API key (x-api-key)
govdealsApiKey.description: Required. Value from the GovDeals API spec. Stored as a secret.

govdealsApiBaseUrl.title: GovDeals API base URL
govdealsApiBaseUrl.description: Leave as default. Overridable for tests.

govdealsRequestDelayMs.title: Delay after each API request (ms)
govdealsRequestDelayMs.description: Pause after every GovDeals API request, in milliseconds. 1000 = about one request per second per worker.

govdealsDetailRefreshHours.title: Detail/fees refresh window (hours)
govdealsDetailRefreshHours.description: Unchanged lots are not re-fetched until this window passes.

govdealsDisplayRows.title: Rows per search page
govdealsDisplayRows.description: Lots per search page. 500 is the maximum (about 51 pages for all lots).

recordFixtures.title: Record real API responses
recordFixtures.description: Saves the first search page (5 rows) and up to 3 detail and bid box responses to the key-value store as FIXTURE_* (no headers or keys).

govdealsIncludeBidBox.title: Fetch bid box (premium, restrictions, bid data)
govdealsIncludeBidBox.description: One extra request per fetched lot: buyer's premium percent, bidder requirements, bid count, bid increment and auction start time.
